scope.coverage: 全41本の代表的な既存操作を小規模・大規模で点検。旧版で成立しない操作・追加APIは別の基準と明示。

environment.optimization: O2; other flags are recorded for each fixture
environment.serialization: 最終比較は共通benchmark.lockで同時計測を避ける。先行探索値は最終値と区別。
environment.timers: steady_clock wall time; std::clock CPU time follows up scheduler/seed-sensitive cases. Both are preserved.
environment.aggregation: 旧/作業開始時/候補/現行を交互に測り中央値。生標本とchecksumを保存。
environment.limits: 特定の入力・コンパイラ・呼出条件での実測で、全入力・全環境の無後退を保証しない。

baseline_policy: 原版、CC0再実装直前、今回の点検開始時のソースは別物としてhashを記録。
旧Radixはコンパイル不能。今回開始時・std::sort・独立参照との比較を旧版との実測とは呼ばない。
旧Node/Trieは骨組みなので、追加操作の参照実装比較と元からある操作を区別する。
SPFAの旧8B Edgeと現在16B Edgeの生比較、幅を揃えた旧算法比較を両方保持。
Nearest旧版はx昇順が前提。正常なcopy+sortを含む比較で、未整列の誤った旧mainを高速な正解とは扱わない。
RollingHashのoriginalは元のconstructor/get、oldはCC0再実装直前で追加APIを持つ版。
根拠となる別日・別版の監査JSONのhashや数値は遡って書き換えない。

Bellman-Ford.cpp: 始点から辺が出ない場合は距離初期化だけで終了
単純路では届かない下限を負影響の印と共用し、専用配列を除去
緩和の再比較を除去し、source一覧は維持してO(VE+V+E)を保持
出辺のある頂点が64個以上なら3パス目以降は更新頂点だけ次パスへ送り、各頂点を1パス1回以下・最大V−1パスに制限
大規模のsource一覧が64個を超えるときだけ一度のreserveで再確保を抑える
64頂点以下は始点・距離・検査状態を固定配列へ載せ、成功後に出力容量を再利用
n*最大辺重み<INFを保証できる大規模経路と検査省略時の小規模経路では未到達INFを直接使い、負影響の頂点だけ-INFへ変換
範囲保証できない大規模経路は従来の狭い内部距離表現と最終overflow_errorを保持
検査有効時、大規模は一時vectorとのswap、小規模は固定配列から成功後assignで例外時の旧出力を保持
Bellman-Ford_SFPA.cpp: 64頂点以下の補助配列とキューをスタックへ配置
n*最大辺重み<INFを保証できる場合は内部未到達値をINFと共用
負影響の距離は伝播時に-INFへ確定し、保証できる範囲では最終の全距離変換を除去
範囲保証できない場合の保守的な距離表現とoverflow_errorを維持
Dijkstra.cpp: 256頂点以下は小さい二分ヒープ処理を保持し、内部INF変換を省略
大規模ではキュー64件超でradix heapへ移行
キューが空で出辺1本なら、次頂点へ直接進んでヒープのpush/popを省略
小規模と大規模で比較型を分け、標準ヒープ操作の共有による別関数化を回避
検査専用のmax_weight/nはSKIPで宣言自体を除去（測定時コードとバイナリ一致）
Floyd-Warshall.cpp: 通常の算術範囲集計に全有限判定を統合
非負・有限範囲を保証できる場合は出力変換と負閉路走査を省略
全要素有限の非負行列では内側の未接続判定も省略
負辺・大重み・負閉路・経路復元と標準算術代替は保持
LCA.cpp: climbのビット列をuint64_tへ変更してGCCのchain照会を改善

comparison_notes: 旧版は可能な限り最初の整備前を使用し、改修直前snapshotはbefore列へ分離した。
BF旧版は辺配列API、現行は隣接リストAPI。比較adapterは距離初期化を計測内、隣接リストから旧辺配列への変換を計測外に置いた（旧版に有利）。
SPFA旧版は8-byte Edge{int,int}、共通型を必須とする現行は16-byte Edge{int,int64_t}。旧アルゴリズムの重みだけ64-bitへ揃えたwide_old列も併記し、元旧版との差は隠していない。
SPFA旧版で利用できるAPIは経路復元付きのみなので、その復元コストも旧計測に含む。ベンチの全非負閉路ケースでは距離checksumが一致。
元のBF負閉路伝播は-INFに重みを繰り返し加算する危険があるため、負閉路の速度だけは最初の旧版と比較せず、正しい直前snapshotを明記した。
BFの旧辺配列から現隣接リストへの差・既定検査の旧出力保持による二重距離バッファは、元旧版の速度との差が残る条件として記録した。BFのO(V)補助状態は継続時のfrontier/nextの2列とscheduledで、各キューは出辺を持つ頂点数以下（vector容量は2倍未満）。
現行の入力検査、負閉路の全下流処理、算術/容量保護、既定検査時の例外で旧出力を保持する性質は維持した。元の旧版はこれらを備えない箇所がある。
通常rollbackの共通ベンチは各操作ごとに文字列で4種類のUFを振り分けるため、専用ループの結果も併記。共通ベンチの後退を消去せず、呼出条件の差として残した。
旧persistentは版のarenaを解放しない。destructionを同等の所有権処理として比較せず、比率はnull。構築と操作の合計も提示できる。
小規模のphase分割にはタイマーや呼出側の展開の影響が含まれる。weighted UFには10回warmup/コンパイラバリア付き構築専用計測を追加した。
全比較をCPU10へ固定し、共有benchmark.lockをcase単位で排他取得。old/newを交互に7回実行、入力とchecksumを共通化した。
LSanはptrace環境で致命エラーとなったため、ASan/UBSanはASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0。リーク検査を通過したという意味ではない。
測定値はこの入力・コンパイラ・CPUでの結果。すべての形状・呼出側コード・機種で速度が後退しないとの主張ではない。

structures.scope: 13 data structure libraries; original behavior benchmarks and separate new-API/reference notes

environment.clock_note: Initial screening uses steady-clock wall time. Final measured cpp wrappers use std::clock process CPU time; units are ms except HashMap/UnionFind/Queue/LiChao seconds. Standard-library clock resolution is1us. Input seed and repeated small workloads are specified in each cpp.

baseline_caveats: Node/Trie old files expose storage only. The benchmark adds matching operations to the old shared_ptr/unordered_map representation; added current APIs are not regressions of an existing old API.
Internal hash old reference is the helper extracted from original 1D BIT. GCC/Clang atcoder imports are removed from baseline snapshots only to permit standalone compilation.
Heap/treap original types are renamed in benchmark reference headers to run old and current operations identically.
Original Li Chao node count may differ; objective result checksum is compared separately.
Wall-clock screening samples are retained. Precision reports use alternating versions, common execution lock, and additional process CPU time to exclude scheduler waits.

changes.Hash_map.cpp: Restore original pre-half-full growth boundary; faster no-tombstone probes, matching tombstone reuse, deduplicated erase checks, and a C++23 internal fresh-iterator invariant. reserve overflow guard follows the revised threshold.
changes.Hash_set.cpp: Compact slots use a union with no active member on default construction. Implicit union copy/move copies object representation (C++23 class.copy.ctor/15); insertion starts the member lifetime with construct_at. Trivially destructible previous keys need no destroy_at. Generic throwing/owning keys retain optional storage. cv qualifiers are removed only from internal storage, public references remain const. This removes unused-key zero initialization and avoids reading indeterminate fields during memberwise slot copies.
changes.Nyaan_hash_map_min.cpp: Standalone default load threshold restored to approximately 80%; choose the random salt lazily once per template specialization. Packed flags and load denominator are independent template parameters for internal consumers. for_each exposes const key/value references without temporary copies; find_nonempty provides a documented allocated-capacity internal lookup.
changes.dynamic-binary-indexed-tree.cpp: Lazy direct storage for n<=64. For65<=n<=1000000, promote after at leastceil(n/8) touched internal nodes; values plus used flags must fit16MiB and default construction/copy assignment must be noexcept. Conversion is amortized over touched nodes, preserves touched-node count, and retains original hash capacity. Allocation failure preserves the just-updated original table and disables conversion until clear/reset. Huge sparse domains keep packed flags. Hash read loops test empty once and use capacity-assured internal lookup thereafter.
changes.dynamic-binary-indexed-tree-2d.cpp: Synchronize shared map and embedded 1D definition. The optimized 2D algorithm/storage stays unchanged; 2D maps explicitly retain their 75% growth policy.
changes.dynamic-union-find.cpp: Shared internal map uses lazy per-specialization salt and retains 75% load policy for existing large-input performance.
changes.Node.cpp: Handle at-most-two-node chains through bounded ordinary shared_ptr destruction before entering the iterative unique-chain destructor. Sharing and long-chain iterative destruction remain protected.
changes.erasable-priority-queue.cpp: Check whether pending deletion heap is empty before checking the value heap during normalization.

residuals: Node raw baseline had only a recursive shared_ptr skeleton. Bulk destruction of 1/2/8-node chains: old 7.107/6.701/6.834 ms vs final equivalent short2 candidate 7.142/7.065/8.361 ms. Unique-ownership checks needed for safe shared/long chains remain. At 4096 nodes old 33.988 ms vs final equivalent candidate 14.623 ms. Raw samples and original candidate source are retained.

HashMap current-source CPU screening: sparse mixed operations +0.7% checked/+1.8% skip, churn +0.9% checked/+4.9% skip relative to the raw baseline. Other measured modes are faster. Repeated candidate trials narrowed the old maintained tiny-case regression; the remaining differences are explicitly retained rather than asserted away.

HashSet final-source reserved200000-key build CPU medians: old1.575/checked1.515/skip1.625ms; lookup old4.207/checked4.119/skip3.844ms. Compared with the pre-task maintained build1.851ms in the separate11-trial matched run, redundant initialization was reduced. Original raw trial groups remain separate, including both faster/slower small residuals.

Node chain_size and the trie convenience methods did not exist in their original storage-only snippets. Their reference operations are useful equivalent workloads, not historical API timing guarantees.

1D sparse-input timings vary with randomized multiplicative salts. Original randomized measurements and all five deterministically selected mixed seeds are retained. Same-seed auxiliary headers replace salt generation only and carry both actual source and derived-header hashes; they do not replace original randomized-source results.

Final1D sparse range sums: randomized current-source CPU medians old13.858ms/checked14.435ms/skip14.239ms. Five identical-salt auxiliary comparisons also retain about2-4% differences; updates and bound searches are faster. Packed-only, empty-check lifting, alternate wrap conditions, cached-mask derivation, scalar-range invariants and independent prefix accumulators were measured; unsuccessful candidates are not installed. All initial randomized samples are retained separately and fixed-seed selection is fully deterministic (five prespecified integers mixed identically).

memory.one_dimensional_bit_object: On GCC and Clang x86-64, sizeof(DynamicFenwickTree<int,int64_t>) and int64_t/int64_t grew from112 to288 bytes. This includes two map policies, the lazy direct-value vector and a direct-used flag vector. Small arrays are allocated only when updated. For n>64 direct storage requires at leastceil(n/8) touched nodes and the additional values/flags budget is16MiB; the prior hash buffers remain allocated, so16MiB is not a total-memory bound. O(n) conversion is O(number_of_touched_nodes) at that threshold; no inspection-only validation scan is added.
memory.two_dimensional_bit_object: sizeof(DynamicFenwickTree2D<int64_t>) stays208 bytes and an ordinary internal uint32_t/int64_t map stays104 bytes. 2D does not contain 1D BIT objects, so embedded definition growth does not increase 2D storage.

independent_hash_review.scope: Independent read-only review of HashSet union CompactSlot lifetime/implicit special members and HashMap BasicIterator std::unreachable invariant
independent_hash_review.conclusion: No correctness defect found for documented valid public operations and supported key types.

HashSet CompactSlot: The union default constructor leaves its value member inactive. Empty/tombstone slots are never read as keys; state_==1 guards value access.

emplace first materializes the new value, then construct_at starts the non-const stored member lifetime. Its selected move construction is noexcept or the const-key path uses the trivial copy constructor. Replacing a trivially destructible old member does not require an explicit destructor call.

reset deliberately leaves the trivial physical member alive and changes only logical state; erase/clear do not read such members. Copying a table can copy these inactive-logical but live-physical values safely.

The implicit union copy constructor copies object representation and begins corresponding nested object lifetimes under C++23 [class.copy.ctor]/15. A nontrivial noexcept default constructor of Key does not need to run during union copying.

The selection requires trivial copy construction and trivial destruction, not a trivial Key move constructor. If Key has a nontrivial move, implicit union move is deleted and ignored by overload resolution; trivial union copying remains available. A supported Key need not itself be trivially copyable.
remove_cv_t storage keeps the complete physical object non-const; accessors preserve the public Key constness. This also supports const class keys with const data members and deleted assignment.
Non-default-constructible/throwing-default or deleted-move types take optional storage when the trait predicate is false; const-key variants were covered independently.
HashMap BasicIterator: Every private constructor call has owner=this, so owner is non-null for a live table. Public default construction and mutable-to-const conversion do not invoke this constructor.
begin/cbegin scan state_ until an occupied bucket or slots_.size(); end/cend pass exactly slots_.size().
find gets either a state_==1 bucket or slots_.size() from locate. Occupied count stays below the half-capacity threshold, guaranteeing a terminating empty bucket.

try_emplace returns an already occupied bucket, or calls mark_inserted after successful slot construction before constructing the iterator. A failed constructor returns no iterator and leaves state unregistered.
erase changes the erased state to 2 and advances the raw index through non-occupied buckets before invoking the private constructor. erase(end()) and the get_next=false form return end directly.
Copy/move/swap/clear/rehash preserve slots_/state_ pairing; invalidated iterators and changed key/hash equivalence rules are outside the documented public preconditions.
